description: Slice a 3D model and return its exact price delivered by USPS Ground Advantage. Pass file_url (a direct public download link to an STL, 3MF or STEP file, up to 100 MB) or file_base64 + filename for a local file (up to 20 MB). Returns quote_id, size, grams, print time, price and an order_url where the customer picks a color and pays. Takes 5-60 seconds for a new file.

file_base64.description: The model file, base64-encoded. Use for files on the user's machine.

file_url.description: Direct download URL of the model (not a web page that shows it).

filename.description: File name with extension, e.g. bracket.stl. Required with file_base64.

qty.description: How many copies to price. Default 1.

name: quote_file
title: Quote a 3D model
